name: iShares Silver Trust (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: SLVon is Ondo's tokenized iShares Silver Trust exposure, a NAV-style ETF tracker for non-U.S. investors rather than a $1 stablecoin.
collateral: Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF exposure referencing iShares Silver Trust (SLV), designed to provide economic exposure to the underlying publicly traded ETF through Ondo GM rather than direct ownership of ETF shares
pegMechanism: NAV-style tokenized ETF tracker rather than a $1 peg; subscriptions, redemptions, and market pricing follow the underlying SLV economic exposure through Ondo Global Markets and eligible investor flows

mintAuthority.summary: SLVon is a centrally issued Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF tracker. Its Ethereum, BSC, and HyperEVM tokens are BeaconProxy deployments whose distinct UpgradeableBeacon owners are 2-hour timelocks. Ethereum's minter and timelock role graph is resolved, but the BSC and HyperEVM terminal timelock authorities are not; Solana remains a separate SPL Token deployment.

controls.label: Ondo Global Markets issuance backend
controls.evidence: Ondo GM mints/redeems SLVon against custodied SLV economic exposure for eligible investors only; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists and eligibility/transfer restrictions are enforced by the issuer.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (MINTER_ROLE[0])
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295049, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) on SLVon ETH returned 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c. Contract verified as GMTokenManager (Ondo's Global Markets issuance contract) on Blockscout.

controls.label: OndoOFT (MINTER_ROLE[1] — bridge)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295049, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) returned 0xf9deffd6164d2b6714f3344cfc35c4f766fa9d6e. Contract verified as OndoOFT (LayerZero OFT bridge) on Blockscout. Enables cross-chain supply bridging.

controls.label: SLVon Ethereum admin and beacon-owner TimelockController (2-hour delay)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531363, getMinDelay() returned 7200. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE had two members: the timelock itself and 5-of-9 Safe 0xcd35671dcab88d05ee29dc4d360181529390b17f. PROPOSER_ROLE had 0x71a4d411b5f7941dee020417fca30413712f1646. EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE each had 0x2e55b738f5969eea10fb67e326bee5e2fa15a2cc and 0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b. The same timelock owns the Ethereum beacon and remains the token DEFAULT_ADMIN, so it can replace mint logic or authorize minters after the 2-hour delay.

controls.label: Ondo governance Safe - Ethereum TimelockController admin (5-of-9)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531363, this Safe remained one of the TimelockController's two DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE members. getOwners() returned the same nine owners, getThreshold() returned 5, getModulesPaginated returned no modules, the guard slot was zero, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, and slot 0 resolved singleton 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a.

controls.label: SLVon deployment-wide beacon-owner timelocks
controls.evidence: This umbrella control exists because the upgradeability schema accepts one controlRef; it does not imply a shared controller. Ethereum beacon 0x985462c9... is owned by timelock 0x3715b215..., BSC beacon 0xc046b05a... by timelock 0x8860bbfc..., and HyperEVM beacon 0x258269e7... by timelock 0x6253fbc5.... Each owner returned getMinDelay() = 7200. Ethereum's role graph is resolved above; the terminal role holders and signer structures behind the BSC and HyperEVM timelocks are intentionally left unresolved.

review.evidence: Sourcify verifies the Ethereum token as BeaconProxy and beacon 0x985462c9... as UpgradeableBeacon. On 2026-07-14, the standard beacon slots on Ethereum, BSC, and HyperEVM resolved respectively to 0x985462c9..., 0xc046b05a..., and 0x258269e7.... Their implementation() calls returned 0xebbcb2ce..., 0x578f397c..., and 0x0d25c65d..., while owner() returned distinct TimelockControllers 0x3715b215..., 0x8860bbfc..., and 0x6253fbc5.... All three timelocks returned a current minimum delay of 7200 seconds. Ethereum's existing direct minters remain GMTokenManager and OndoOFT; the Ethereum timelock role graph is current and its admin Safe remains 5-of-9 with no modules or guard. BSC and HyperEVM terminal timelock role holders/signers were not established by this ruling, and the Solana deployment remains an SPL Token mint outside the EVM beacon graph, so the asset-wide authority profile is not scoreable yet.
unresolvedQuestions: Which terminal accounts control the BSC and HyperEVM timelocks' admin, proposer, executor, and canceller roles, and what signer thresholds, modules, or guards apply?
Which terminal authority controls the Solana SPL mint and any bridge-mediated mint path?

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SLVon is an Ondo Global Markets token, and Ondo documents its token bridge as a LayerZero-based bridge for Global Markets assets, including bridging to HyperEVM. Pharos scores this as external lock/mint/OFT-style route exposure.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

routes.reviewNote: Native SLVon: MINTER_ROLE enumeration (read 2026-07-20) shows the Ondo GMTokenManager 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c (12,828-byte issuance contract) plus the chain's OndoOFT as the two mint authorities. Ondo Global Markets issues natively on this chain.

Native SLVon: MINTER_ROLE enumeration (read 2026-07-20) shows the Ondo GMTokenManager 0x91f8aff3738825e8eb16fc6f6b1a7a4647bdb299 (12,828-byte issuance contract) plus the chain's OndoOFT as the two mint authorities. Ondo Global Markets issues natively on this chain.

SLVon on Solana shares the Ondo program mint authority PDA 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD (no SOL account exists at the address — a program-derived mint authority, read 2026-07-20 via Solana RPC); freeze authority 51QVCuHfL1FeNjd8BDeffCKhCcAYoULnVB3yjNhShiuK is Ondo's. DefiLlama attributes Solana SLVon supply to Ondo's cross-chain deployment.

SLVon on HyperEVM is minted solely by the OndoOFT contract 0x7b97e37f7ec5271ef24eb2a3c5bd1fcf308c2a85 (sole MINTER_ROLE member, read 2026-07-20): a 6,152-byte LayerZero OApp with endpoint() = HyperEVM LZ V2 endpoint 0x3a73033c0b1407574c76bdbac67f126f6b4a9aa9 and token() = this deployment.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: SLVon resolves to Yes because it is a centrally issued Ondo GM tokenized ETF product with eligibility restrictions and issuer-controlled subscription, redemption, and transfer infrastructure.

reserves.name: iShares Silver Trust (SLV) economic exposure via Ondo Global Markets collateral accounts
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited; iShares Silver Trust (BlackRock) shares held at US-registered custodial broker-dealers

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
reserveReview.rationale: Ondo documents SLVon as fully backed by iShares Silver Trust ETF shares plus cash in transit, with Ankura Trust Company providing daily third-party verification of holdings; the reserve is therefore the SLV ETF exposure itself, held through Ondo Global Markets collateral accounts. Custodian identities and the cash-buffer share are not published, which is recorded as a custody known-unknown rather than a composition gap.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ondo Global Markets product and trust disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset is unclassified; custodial broker-dealer identities and the cash-in-transit share are undisclosed (tracked in the custody profile).

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: Ondo GM Tokens provide economic exposure to the underlying ETF but do not give holders direct rights to hold or receive the underlying ETF shares; eligibility restrictions apply.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: SLVon is a tokenized fund-security exposure tracking the iShares Silver Trust through Ondo Global Markets, not allocated physical bullion.
